logo: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: square iOS/watchOS app icon for an app called Enchant. Create an original Minecraft-inspired voxel pixel-art icon: one chunky diagonal enchanted turquoise sword, compact angular silhouette, purple gem pommel and two tiny square magical sparks. Dark obsidian purple square background fills image edge to edge; no rounded corners (OS supplies mask). Crisp stair-stepped pixel edges, restrained 16-bit palette, hand-crafted premium game-inventory aesthetic, readable at 40 pixels. Generous safe margins. No text, no letters, no Minecraft logos, no copied game textures. Single icon only, no mockups or borders.

plainSword.prompt: Edit the approved pixel sword into its unenchanted state. Preserve the original diagonal cyan blade, stepped silhouette, dark teal outline, handle, scale and transparent background. Remove all purple magical sparks, glints and enchantment aura. Keep a plain dark teal pommel. No text, no UI, no new background.

enhancedSword.prompt: Improve only the enchantment. Preserve the exact upward-right cyan blade silhouette, stepped thickness and length, aqua crossguard, leather handle and violet gem pommel of the approved sword. Add lavender iridescent highlight bands across existing crystal facets, violet dark-edge accents and a few crisp squared motes. Keep the blade mostly turquoise and recognizably the same sword. Uniform pixel grid, transparent background; no blurry bloom, clouds, text or extra objects.

Use the same enhanced cyan sword, diagonal shape, crossguard, leather handle, violet pommel and lavender blade sheen as the in-app sprite.
